conflicts_and_limits: Ninety-percent sample coverage is not this project's exhaustive acceptance denominator.
Boolean sample strings require actual typed schema compatibility validation.
Sample jq selection may silently omit missing-property rows; missing marker alone is not complete census.
Compliance example properties are not authoritative legal applicability or required controls.
Naming-prefix and repository deletion suggestions cannot override approved repository identity or custody constraints.
Current definition limits, roles and lifecycle policy features need live supported-platform validation.
